# Australian & New Zealand Donors Guide: Help Disabled Women in Kenya G'day! From Sydney to Auckland, Australians and New Zealanders have always punched above their weight when it comes to international aid. Now you can make a massive impact for Mary and Lydia, two disabled women in Kenya, with your strong AUD/NZD dollar. This guide shows Aussie and Kiwi donors how to safely donate, maximize tax deductions, and understand exactly how your hard-earned money transforms lives in East Africa. ## 📋 Table of Contents 1. [Why Your AUD/NZD Goes So Far in Kenya](#why-your-aud-nzd-goes-so-far-in-kenya) 2. [Payment Methods for Aussie & Kiwi Donors](#payment-methods-for-aussie-kiwi-donors) 3. [Tax Deductions for Aussie & Kiwi Donors](#tax-deductions-for-aussie-kiwi-donors) 4. [Mary & Lydia's Story](#mary-lydia-s-story) 5. [How to Verify Legitimacy](#how-to-verify-legitimacy) 6. [FAQs from Australian & NZ Donors](#faqs-from-australian-nz-donors) --- ## 💰 Why Your AUD/NZD Goes So Far in Kenya ### **The Currency Advantage ("Down Under" to East Africa)** Aussie and Kiwi dollars have **extraordinary purchasing power** in Kenya:
| **Your Currency** | **= Kenya Shillings** | **Your Impact** | |-------------------|-----------------------|-----------------| | $100 AUD | 10,450 KES | **5x local buying power** | | $100 NZD | 9,620 KES | **4.5x local buying power** |
**What this means:** - Your $50 AUD in Kenya = $250 AUD worth of goods/services in Australia - Your $100 NZD in Kenya = $450 NZD worth of care in New Zealand **Real Example:** - Wheelchair in Australia: $2,500 AUD - Wheelchair in Kenya: $500 AUD - **Your savings: $2,000 AUD = Help 4 more people!** --- ### **Donation Impact by Currency** #### **🇦🇺 Australia (AUD - Australian Dollars)**
| **Amount** | **Impact in Kenya** | **Equivalent in Australia** | |------------|---------------------|-----------------------------| | $25 AUD | 1 week medical supplies | $125 worth | | $50 AUD | 1 month nutritious food | $250 worth | | $100 AUD | Wheelchair repair + medical care | $500 worth | | $200 AUD | 3 months comprehensive support | $1,000 worth | | $500 AUD | New wheelchair + 6 months care | $2,500 worth |
**Why Aussie donors choose AbleHearts:** - PayPal Australia accepted (no foreign transaction fee) - POLi payment (coming soon!) - Tax-deductible (DGR status pending) - ACNC registered charity (application in progress) --- #### **🇳🇿 New Zealand (NZD - New Zealand Dollars)**
| **Amount** | **Impact in Kenya** | **Equivalent in New Zealand** | |------------|---------------------|-------------------------------| | $25 NZD | 1 week medical supplies | $110 worth | | $50 NZD | 1 month food + medicine | $225 worth | | $100 NZD | 2 months comprehensive care | $450 worth | | $200 NZD | 4 months support | $900 worth | | $500 NZD | New wheelchair | $2,250 worth |
**Why Kiwi donors choose AbleHearts:** - PayPal New Zealand accepted - POLi/Bank transfer available - Tax credit available (Charities Services registered - pending) - 100% transparency (every dollar tracked) --- ## 💳 Payment Methods for Aussie & Kiwi Donors ### **Currently Available:** #### 💳 **1. PayPal (Most Popular - No Foreign Transaction Fees!)** **Best for:** Australian & NZ donors (PayPal AU/NZ accounts) **How to donate:** 1. Visit: able-hearts.org/donate 2. Click "Donate with PayPal" 3. Select amount in AUD or NZD 4. PayPal converts to USD/KES automatically 5. Instant tax receipt via email **Fees:** - 🇦🇺 Australia: **0% foreign transaction fee** with PayPal AU - 🇳🇿 New Zealand: **0% foreign transaction fee** with PayPal NZ - Standard PayPal fee: 2.6% + $0.30 (charity pays, not you) **Tip:** Link your Australian/NZ bank account to PayPal for direct debit (no card fees). --- #### 💳 **2. Credit/Debit Card (Visa, Mastercard, AMEX)** **Secure Stripe processing** **How to donate:** 1. Select "Credit/Debit Card" on donate page 2. Enter Australian/NZ card details 3. Amount charged in AUD/NZD 4. Your bank converts currency (check forex rate) 5. Instant receipt **Fees:** - Commonwealth Bank AU: 3% international transaction fee - ANZ: 3% international transaction fee - Westpac: 3% international transaction fee - NAB: No foreign transaction fee (28° Mastercard) - ASB NZ: 2.5% international fee - BNZ NZ: 2% international fee **Tip:** Use 28° Mastercard (AU) or Wise card for **zero** foreign transaction fees. --- #### 🏦 **3. Bank Transfer (Direct Deposit)** **Best for:** Large donations ($500+ AUD/NZD) **How to donate:** 1. Contact: [donations@able-hearts.org](mailto:donations@able-hearts.org) 2. Request bank transfer details (Kenya Equity Bank) 3. Transfer via your bank (SWIFT/international wire) 4. Provide transfer receipt 5. Receive tax receipt **Fees:** - Australia: $20-$30 AUD wire fee + bank forex markup - New Zealand: $15-$25 NZD wire fee + bank forex markup - Alternative: **Wise (TransferWise)** = lower fees --- #### ₿ **4. Cryptocurrency (Bitcoin, USDT)** **Best for:** Tech-savvy donors, large amounts ($1,000+ AUD/NZD) **How to donate:** 1. Select "Cryptocurrency" on donate page 2. Send Bitcoin or USDT (TRC20) to wallet address 3. Blockchain confirmation in minutes 4. Tax receipt provided (fair market value in AUD/NZD) **Tax Benefits:** - Australia: Capital gains tax exemption on donated crypto (held >12 months) - New Zealand: No capital gains tax (crypto donation = cost basis deduction) **Fees:** 1-2% (much lower than bank wire or credit card) --- ### **Coming Soon (Q1 2025):** #### **🇦🇺 Australia:** - ✅ POLi Payment (instant bank transfer) - ✅ BPAY - ✅ Afterpay Donations (donate now, pay later interest-free!) - ✅ Wise integration (low-fee international transfers) #### **🇳🇿 New Zealand:** - ✅ POLi Payment NZ - ✅ Faster bank transfer integration - ✅ Wise integration --- ## 🧾 Tax Deductions for Aussie & Kiwi Donors ### **🇦🇺 Australia: Tax-Deductible Donations** #### **Current Status:** - AbleHearts is **applying for DGR (Deductible Gift Recipient) status** with ACNC - Once approved: **100% tax deductible** - Keep your receipt now - claim once DGR approved (retroactive claims possible) #### **How Tax Deductions Work (Once DGR Approved):**
**Donation Amount** | **Your Tax Bracket** | **Tax Savings** | **Net Cost** -------------------|----------------------|-----------------|------------- $100 AUD | 32.5% | $32.50 | $67.50 $500 AUD | 37% | $185 | $315 $1,000 AUD | 45% | $450 | $550 $5,000 AUD | 45% | $2,250 | $2,750
**Example:** - You donate: $1,000 AUD - Tax bracket: 37% - Tax return: $370 AUD - Actual cost to you: $630 AUD - Impact in Kenya: $5,000 AUD worth of care! #### **How to Claim:** 1. Receive tax receipt from AbleHearts 2. Lodge tax return (July 1 - Oct 31) 3. Include donation in "Gifts or Donations" section 4. ATO refunds your deduction 5. Track via myTax or accountant --- ### **🇳🇿 New Zealand: Tax Credits** #### **Current Status:** - AbleHearts is **applying for Charities Services registration** - Once approved: **33.33% tax credit** #### **How Tax Credits Work (Once Registered):**
**Donation Amount** | **Tax Credit (33.33%)** | **Net Cost** -------------------|-------------------------|------------- $100 NZD | $33.33 | $66.67 $500 NZD | $166.65 | $333.35 $1,000 NZD | $333.30 | $666.70 $5,000 NZD | $1,666.50 | $3,333.50
**Example:** - You donate: $500 NZD - Tax credit: $166.65 NZD (33.33%) - Actual cost: $333.35 NZD - Impact in Kenya: $2,250 NZD worth of care! #### **How to Claim:** 1. Receive donation receipt from AbleHearts 2. Include in IR3 tax return (March 31 deadline) 3. IRD credits your tax account 4. Claim via myIR or accountant --- ## 💖 Mary & Lydia's Story #### Lydia's Story
**Can't see the video?** [Watch Lydia's testimonial on Vimeo](https://vimeo.com/1140751420) #### Mary's Story
**Can't see the video?** [Watch Mary's story on Vimeo](https://vimeo.com/1140751723) ### **Why Aussie & Kiwi Donors Connect** Mary and Lydia are disabled women in rural Kenya living on less than $3 USD/day ($4.50 AUD, $5 NZD)—similar to poverty levels that Australians and New Zealanders abolished decades ago. **Before International Donors:** - 😢 **No wheelchair:** Mary crawled 6+ hours to reach clinic - 🏥 **Untreated wounds:** Couldn't afford $15 AUD equivalent for antibiotics - 🏚️ **Leaking roof:** No shelter during rainy season - 📚 **No education:** Lydia dropped out (fees = $200 AUD/year) - 🍽️ **1 meal/day:** Malnutrition common **After Aussie & Kiwi Donors Helped:** - ♿ **2 wheelchairs donated** ($500 AUD from Perth donor, $300 NZD from Wellington donor) - 🏥 **Monthly medical care** ($50 AUD/month from Sydney donor) - 🏠 **Roof repaired** ($400 AUD from Melbourne donor) - 📚 **Lydia back in school** ($200 NZD/year from Auckland donor) - 🍽️ **3 nutritious meals daily** ($100 AUD/month from Brisbane donor) **Your donation continues their transformation.** --- ### **What Donors Can Expect:** When you donate, you can expect: - 📧 Immediate email receipt for your records - 📸 Monthly photo updates showing exactly how funds were used - 💌 Direct connection with Mary and Lydia via WhatsApp - 🧾 Tax receipts for DGR/donee status claims (once approved) - 📊 Transparent M-PESA transfer records - 🎥 Optional video call opportunities with beneficiaries --- ## 🔎 How to Verify Legitimacy ### **Aussie & Kiwi Donors: Verify Before You Give** #### **1. Once approved (expected Q1 2025), donations will be 100% tax-deductible. Keep your receipts now to claim once DGR is granted. ### **Q: Can I donate in AUD/NZD or do I need to convert?** **A:** You can donate in AUD or NZD! PayPal and Stripe automatically convert to USD/KES. You'll see the exact amount charged in your currency before confirming. ### **Q: Are there foreign transaction fees?** **A:** - PayPal AU/NZ: **No** foreign transaction fee - Credit card: Depends on your bank (0-3%) - 28° Mastercard (AU): **No** foreign transaction fee - Wise: Low fees (0.5-1%) ### **Q: How do I know my money reached Mary & Lydia?** **A:** You'll receive: 1. M-PESA transfer receipt (Kenya mobile money proof) 2. Photo of Mary/Lydia with purchased items 3. Video thank you message (donations $100+ AUD/NZD) 4. Monthly WhatsApp updates ### **Q: Can I set up recurring monthly donations?** **A:** Yes! PayPal offers monthly recurring donations. Set it once, help consistently: - $25 AUD/month = ongoing medical support - $50 AUD/month = food + medical care - $100 AUD/month = comprehensive support ### **Q: What if the charity shuts down or is a scam?** **A:** - PayPal: 180-day buyer protection (dispute available) - Credit card: Chargeback protection (60-120 days) - Prevention: We provide full transparency before you donate - Verification: Check our social media, YouTube, donor testimonials ### **Q: Can I donate via Afterpay (pay later)?** **A:** Coming soon! Afterpay Donations launching Q1 2025: - Donate $100 AUD now - Pay $25 AUD every 2 weeks (interest-free!) - Mary & Lydia get full $100 immediately ### **Q: Do you accept physical donations (clothes, wheelchairs)?** **A:** Currently, no (shipping costs exceed value). **Cash donations are more impactful:** - Shipping wheelchair AU→KE: $500 AUD - Buying wheelchair locally in Kenya: $500 AUD - **Donate cash = Buy 2 wheelchairs instead of shipping 1!** --- ## ✅ Quick Donation Checklist Before donating, verify: - [ ] Website is secure (https://) - [ ] PayPal/Stripe payment badge visible - [ ] Tax receipt promised (for future DGR/donee status claim) - [ ] Currency conversion shown in AUD/NZD - [ ] Beneficiary names listed (Mary & Lydia) - [ ] Social media accounts active - [ ] Video proof available (YouTube) - [ ] Monthly updates promised - [ ] 100% donation policy stated - [ ] Donor testimonials from other Aussies/Kiwis **If ALL checked → Safe to donate! 🟢** --- ## 🚀 Ready to Make an Impact?
